verdict.rationale: The forms directory is published with PDF versions and instructions, downloadable without an account (Form 205, Form 401, etc.), which provides the paper-form piece of a fallback rail. However, the evidence frames filing and ordering around SOSPortal only, and no mailing address, fax number, or in-person submission instructions are shown. Missing for 10: published mailing address for paper filings, fax number and fax-filing procedure, explicit guidance on submitting forms offline when SOSPortal is unavailable.
